carbon.$description: Carbon — Primary text, card borders, filled CTA background, logo mark — creates the hand-cut sticker outline effect against pastel surfaces

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Page canvas, card surfaces, outlined button fills, text on dark fills

sky-wash.$description: Sky Wash — Hero section background, light blue pastel ground

concrete-gray.$description: Concrete Gray — Secondary section background, neutral interlude surface

soft-mist.$description: Soft Mist — Subtle button and surface tints, disabled states

electric-blue.$description: Electric Blue — Dominant brand color — 3D ribbon sculptures, body backgrounds, card washes, the visual signature that anchors every screen

mint-pop.$description: Mint Pop — Green wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content

lavender.$description: Lavender — Soft accent wash for cards, tags, sticker fills — the gentlest color in the palette

ember.$description: Ember — Hot accent for sticker icons, badge fills, rocket body — warmest hit in the rainbow

sunburst.$description: Sunburst — Sticker coin fills, highlight accents, yellow sticker decorations — never used for text backgrounds

voltage-violet.$description: Voltage Violet — Deep accent for wallet stickers, QR download cards, secondary CTAs — the anchor purple in the sticker set

lateral.$description: Display headlines only — the wordmark 'SLUSH' and section banners like 'ALL THINGS SUI' sit at 200–640px with crushed 0.75–0.80 line-height so the letters stack into sculptural blocks. This is anti-convention display: no other site pairs an 800-weight display face with line-height under 0.85, and the effect makes text behave like a physical object that wraps behind 3D ribbons.

aeonik-pro.$description: All UI, body, nav, buttons, subheads. Weight 500 for body and metadata (12–16px), weight 700 for subheads and nav labels (24–30px), and a 64px 700-weight step for large supporting headlines. Tight letter-spacing (-0.010em) tightens the 14–16px body; slight opening (0.030–0.032em) on nav/button labels gives pill controls breathing room.
